Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment exploration — next steps

Hi Tessa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme is excited to move from POC to an evaluation of a private/VPC deployment. Security and network are top of mind for us — our InfoSec lead wants a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that lists owners for VPN/networking, IAM/KMS, and a tentative timeline to close.

Can you kick off a MAP draft and propose stakeholders from Redwood so we can align on internal owners? Ideally we'd aim to complete the evaluation and have a procurement window by mid-September.

Jordan
Jordan Lee
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Inc.

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Private deployment connectivity & owner roster

Jordan — thanks, and good call on a MAP. I'm looping in our lead for network onboarding (Karthik), our solutions lead (Grace) and enterprise account lead (Vivek).

Attached is an initial MAP draft that proposes a 6-week evaluation sprint and calls out the key milestones we normally track:
- Week 0: MAP alignment + stakeholder roster
- Week 1–2: Networking/VPN PoC + KMS integration validation
- Week 3–4: Load/stability tests + performance baselines
- Week 5: Security evidence & compliance checklist
- Week 6: Decision & procurement window (target: 2027-09-15)

Action items for this thread:
1) Acme — please confirm IAM/KMS owner and security SME to work with our infra team.
2) Redwood — we'll assign day-to-day owners and share test accounts by end of this week.
3) Schedule a 60-min MAP kickoff this coming Thursday to agree on acceptance criteria.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP timeline + acceptance criteria), network-topology-sketch.drawio (high-level), soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (what we usually request).

I'll propose a meeting time in a follow-up calendar invite.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Growth — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — network/VPN owners and topology notes

Jordan / team — quick note from the networking side. For Private/VPC deployments we typically validate three connectivity patterns:
1) Site-to-site VPN (customer-managed edge)
2) Private peering / VPC peering (cloud provider dependent)
3) Transit + firewall-controlled egress with strict CIDR allowlists

For the MAP I'd like to confirm the following owners from Acme:
- Network owner (VPN endpoints, firewall rules) — name/email
- Cloud infra owner (VPC peering, route tables) — name/email
- Security/KMS owner (key lifecycle, rotation policies) — name/email

Also: can Acme share the CIDR ranges and whether you require static egress IPs? If you prefer, we can run the connectivity checks in our staging VPC first to minimize hit to production.

I'll add a short checklist to the MAP draft that maps each connectivity pattern to test steps and expected success criteria.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation criteria and sprint commitments

Jordan — adding a short note on acceptance criteria and eval logistics so we have clarity ahead of the kickoff:
- Security acceptance: all SOC2 checklist items in the attached spreadsheet marked as provided or in-progress. Evidence to be uploaded to Acme's secure folder by Week 5.
- Performance acceptance: 95th p50 p95 latency baselines for your target r/s (we'll run the load script we discussed).
- Operational acceptance: successful cold/warm failover between zones and clear runbook for key rotation (KMS).

I can steward the eval scripts and coordinate the run windows — Karthik, I'll need the staging CIDRs and test accounts. Vivek — can you confirm the procurement/contract handshake once the MAP is green? We're proposing target close 2027-09-15 but open if Acme needs more time.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
